facts.text: Caroline joined a new LGBTQ activist group called 'Connected LGBTQ Activists' on Tuesday, which meets regularly and organizes events and campaigns.

evidence.quote: I just joined a new LGBTQ activist group last Tues.
Our group, 'Connected LGBTQ Activists', is made of all kinds of people investing in positive changes. We have regular meetings, plan events and campaigns, to get together and support each other.

facts.text: Caroline attended a city pride parade last weekend, which featured people marching through the streets waving flags and holding signs to celebrate love and diversity.

evidence.quote: Last weekend our city held a pride parade! So many people marched through the streets waving flags, holding signs and celebrating love and diversity.
